headline: JUCO first or D1 walk-on?
caption:
Baseball parents, here's a fun one. Would you rather your player:

A) Spend two years at a JUCO, play a lot, then transfer to a four-year school
B) Walk on at a D1 program and work to earn a roster spot and innings

There's no wrong answer. Each path fits a different player.

⚾ JUCO can mean more reps, more development time and a second look from four-year coaches.
⚾ A D1 walk-on gets him in a top program, but a roster spot and playing time are never promised.

The best choice usually comes down to where his numbers fit today and how much he still has to grow.

Which would you pick, A or B? Tell us below 👇

See what the numbers say about your player's best fit:
